description: A 5km one-way hiking trail to a rustic (and I mean rustic) campsite on Johnson Lake with a short side trail to Jenyo Lake (Carrier name means "bull moose"). All terrain vehicles prohibited.
directions: Trailhead at 54 km Kluskus - parking on the East (opposite) side of the road.

stats.Closure: The Recreation Site/Trail is closed due to danger trees and excessive blowdown. A significant risk to public health and safety exists and this trail should not be utilized or occupied.

title: Johnson Lake Trail
